maria_chang: Heads up — several customers in EU are hitting a weird flow. After yesterday's RBAC role rename + KMS rekey, users are getting forced into an MFA re-enroll loop. Support has screenshots from 3 customers. @alex_ruiz @sec-bot :eyes:

alex_ruiz: Do we have SAML assertion dumps? Could be NameID or audience mismatch after the role rename or cert swap.

dave_ops: Observability: SCIM deprovision calls timed out and 502'd at ~03:40 UTC. Provisioning service shows KMS decrypt errors: `DECRYPT_FAILED: malformed ciphertext`.

maria_chang: Support screenshots show SAML error page with 'Invalid audience' referencing urn:redwood:ui. These orgs normally are fine. No mass outage.

alex_ruiz: We didn't rotate SAML certs. We *did* rekey a KMS key for service-account tokens this morning (key-id: proj/redwood/sa-token-rot1). SCIM tokens use that key to seal external IDs. If decrypt fails, deprov retries could leave user state inconsistent -> IdP might treat user as not-enrolled for MFA.

dave_ops: Logs summary: `audit.scim.deliveries.fail=12` in last hour; `sso.authn.invalid_audience=7`; `kms.decrypt.fail=27`. Looks correlated around the key rotate window.

sec-bot: Runbook pointer: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/sso/kms-decrypt-check. Steps: verify kms key versions, clear local seal cache, restart provisioner worker.

alex_ruiz: I'll re-init the KMS client and clear the token seal cache on one prod node as a canary. Plan: prod-1 only, monitor 15m. If decrypt failures stop, roll. Setting env KMS_KEY_VERSION=v2 and clear /var/lib/redwood/sealcache.

maria_chang: Before rollout, capture audit logs for potential data access and notify SOC. Also hold any more RBAC renames for 24h until postmortem.

dave_ops: Also seeing an odd SCIM 409 on one org: duplicate extId during retry — suggests deprov partially completed then retried. Keep an eye for ghosts.

alex_ruiz: Canary running. Prod-1 after restart: decrypt_failures -> 0, scim retries cleared. Pushing to prod-2 now.

maria_chang: Nice. Ping support with a short workaround: advise affected users to clear browser cookies and retry (temporary). We'll follow up with customers once stable.

dave_ops: Rolling to prod-3 done. Metrics: KMS decrypt errors fell from ~27 to 1 across cluster. SCIM fail rate back to baseline.

alex_ruiz: Root cause notes: key rotation didn't invalidate local seal caches in long-running provisioner processes. They kept trying old ciphertext and KMS returned decrypt errors. Deprov retries caused attribute drift (mfa_enrolled flag flipped) leading to IdP triggering re-enroll. Added a short-term tolerant check for old audience strings during rollout to avoid immediate SAML rejections.

maria_chang: Follow-ups (JIRA): alex -> SEC-452 add idempotent KMS client refresh + force cache invalidation; dave -> SEC-453 add prometheus alert for kms.decrypt.fail spikes and SCIM ghost rate; maria -> SEC-454 customer comms + postmortem doc.

alex_ruiz: Will file SEC-452 and include a small script to rotate caches safely.

dave_ops: I'll prepare a short postmortem draft and attach logs.

maria_chang: Thanks all. Assigning a 72h freeze on RBAC role renames until postmortem done. Closing this thread once SEC tickets and postmortem links are added. :thumbsup: :heart:
